verdict.rationale: Docs mention auto-generated per-workspace API documentation with 'an interactive playground where you can execute real calls against your data' (twenty-docs-8, twenty-docs-61), which supports the story's core claim of runnable examples. However, a probe found no public OpenAPI/swagger spec discoverable at standard paths, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the playground's usability or a general public API explorer outside a live workspace. missing for 10: independent verification of the playground's runnable-example experience, a publicly accessible API reference (not workspace-gated), and evidence of REST/GraphQL example completeness.
